ica-se.name: ICA:s säsongskalender
ica-se.review_note: All twelve monthly lists reviewed. Positive examples, not proof of absence or complete season boundaries. See docs/source-decision.md. All twelve lists reviewed again on 2026-09-14 for the third catalogue expansion; conditional January kale availability retained in its ingredient note.

fran-sverige.name: Från Sveriges säsongsguider
fran-sverige.review_note: All twelve currently linked posters visually reviewed for the ten sample ingredients. January-April filenames are 2027; May-December are 2026. Used for raspberries listed in June-August. See docs/evidence/source-comparison-2026-09-13.json.

sydgront-calendar.name: SydGrönts produktkalender
sydgront-calendar.review_note: Visually reviewed monthly grid and product ranges. Used for carrots and the catalogue additions documented in docs/source-decision.md. Supplier availability includes storage and protected cultivation; it is not a national harvest calendar. The 2025 edition remained the latest calendar found on 2026-09-19.

sasongensbasta-aubergine.name: Säsongens Bästa: Aubergine
sasongensbasta-aubergine.review_note: Explicitly states that Swedish-grown aubergine is available May-October, in limited quantities.

sasongensbasta-kal.name: Säsongens Bästa: Kål
sasongensbasta-kal.review_note: The cabbage overview explicitly gives June-October for Swedish Chinese cabbage (salladskål).

sasongensbasta-lok.name: Säsongens Bästa: Lök
sasongensbasta-lok.review_note: Explicitly gives May-August for Swedish spring onion. SydGrönt gives May-October; the catalogue follows the selected primary source and therefore classifies September-October as out of season.

sasongensbasta-artskidor.name: Säsongens Bästa: Ärtskidor och bönor
sasongensbasta-artskidor.review_note: The page covers sugar peas and wax beans and gives July-October as the Swedish season. SydGrönt starts sugar peas in June; the catalogue follows the selected primary source and therefore classifies June as out of season.

hebe-plommon.name: Hebe Frukt & Grönt
hebe-plommon.review_note: The Swedish plum section explicitly gives August into September. Do not apply pear cultivar dates from the same page to plums.
